correctness.rationale: The defining graph is exactly generalized Petersen GP(10,2): edges u_i u_{i+1}, u_i v_i, v_i v_{i+2} (indices mod10). Independently generated all independent vertex subsets recursively: exactly 5,828 with empty face, nonempty size counts 20,160,660,1510,1912,1240,320,5. Independently constructed vertex-order greedy matching on 5,827 nonempty faces with 2,911 matched covers and 5 critical cells: one singleton {0} and four specified 6-vertex faces. Constructed all 27,620 oriented Hasse edges and topologically sorted all 5,827 vertices: acyclic. A perfect finite Forman matching with one 0-cell and four 5-cells gives wedge of four S^5, because all 5-cell attachments land in the sole 0-skeleton. Euler characteristic −3 supports the result but does not establish homotopy type.

value.rationale: An explicit homotopy invariant of the canonical dodecahedron graph is a natural previously undetermined exact case. The finite acyclic matching proves a complete homotopy classification, strictly beyond an Euler characteristic or homology table; it is useful to compare independence complexes of Platonic and generalized Petersen graphs without requiring a family theorem.

limitations: Single finite graph, no Platonic-graph family theorem or equivariant homotopy type.
Finite proof uses exhaustive checking, not a symbolic classification of all gradient paths.
